会话服务异常，请刷新重试。: Session service error. Refresh and retry.

请立即复制并安全送达用户；服务端只保留哈希，无法再次取出。: Copy and deliver it to the user now; the server keeps only a hash and cannot show it again.

该账号当前有效的登录会话(refresh token);短时访问令牌不在此列。只: Active sign-in sessions (refresh tokens) for this account; short-lived access tokens are not listed. Read-only view.
保存后该用户全部令牌立即失效。邮箱变更会重置「邮箱已验证」；留空即清空该字段。: Saving revokes all of the user's tokens immediately. Changing the email resets "email verified"; leave a field blank to clear it.
授予管理员角色失败: Failed to grant the admin role
移除管理员角色失败: Failed to remove the admin role
Claim 类型、值和 scope 均不能为空: Claim type, value and scope are all required
其全部登录令牌将立即失效。: All of their login tokens will be revoked immediately.
解冻后账号可正常登录。: The account can sign in normally after unfreezing.
当前密码将失效，其所有会话将被强制下线。新密码仅显示一次。: The current password becomes invalid and all their sessions are signed out. The new password is shown only once.
变更将吊销其全部令牌（立即生效）。: The change revokes all of their tokens (effective immediately).
将清除临时锁定与连续失败计数。: Clears the temporary lockout and failed-attempt count.
将关闭 2FA 并吊销其全部令牌（该账号会被强制下线）。: Turns off 2FA and revokes all their tokens (the account is signed out).
将关闭 2FA 并吊销其全部令牌（该账号会被强制下线，包括你当前的管理台会话）。: Turns off 2FA and revokes all their tokens (the account is signed out, including your current admin session).
仅吊销其全部令牌（立即生效），账号状态与凭据不变；该用户需重新登录才能再访问。: Only revokes their tokens (immediately); account status and credentials are unchanged. They must sign in again to regain access.
删除后即刻生效；添加和删除 Claim 都会记录管理审计。: Deletion is immediate; adding and removing claims are audit-logged.
注销为不可恢复操作：账号将无法登录、全部会话立即失效，管理台不提供恢复入口。: Deactivation is irreversible: the account can no longer sign in, all sessions end immediately, and the console offers no recovery path.
如确认，请原样输入该用户的用户名: To confirm, type the username exactly as shown
选择角色以查看和管理其自定义 Claims。: Select a role to view and manage its custom claims.
点击查看与编辑；机密客户端（confidential）持有密钥，公共客户端（pu: Click to view and edit; confidential clients hold a secret, public clients rely on PKCE.
每行一个 URL；保存为整体替换。: One URL per line; saving replaces the whole list.
复选即启用；保存为整体替换，服务端校验未知形态。: Check to enable; saving replaces the whole list; the server validates unknown forms.
第一方/平台客户端由部署流程维护，管理台只读。: First-party/platform clients are maintained by the deployment pipeline; this console is read-only.
第一方/平台客户端由部署流程维护，管理台不提供密钥轮换。: First-party/platform clients are maintained by the deployment pipeline; the console does not offer secret rotation.
生成 32 字节随机密钥，明文只显示一次；旧密钥与既有令牌立即作废。: Generates a 32-byte random secret, shown once; the old secret and existing tokens are voided immediately.
旧密钥与既有令牌立即作废，新密钥仅显示一次。: The old secret and existing tokens are voided immediately; the new one is shown once.
旧密钥立即作废，新密钥仅显示一次。: The old secret is voided immediately; the new one is shown once.

依赖旧密钥的集成需尽快更新。: Integrations depending on the old secret must update soon.
